interpretation: CONFIRM_REMOVE_WRONG_LINK means disconnect the indicated specific frozen teaching Sense link only after CG-MASTER approval; never delete Master row or lemma.
CONFIRM_HOLD_SCOPE means supplied target use exceeds the literal frozen definition; seek more appropriate Sense or authoritative sense expansion.
HOLD_REQUIRE_SCENE_CONTEXT means a clear release decision cannot be reached from record-level gloss alone, and richer source-scene example is essential.
